# Atlas Charts periodic versus nonperiodic date binning — facts

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] For Month bins, a custom date format can include year only with Periodic disabled. Enabling Periodic removes year from valid formatting choices. Labels cannot include time units finer than the bin size; Charts highlights invalid formats in red. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/customize-charts/field-level-options.md · keywords: Atlas Charts periodic versus nonperiodic date binning · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/bin-data.md
- [statement] University of Malta researchers report generating periodic mean and raw air-quality charts with MongoDB Charts. Their chapter does not document the Periodic toggle, so it cannot independently verify its exact binning semantics. (low confidence) — https://doi.org/10.5772/intechopen.1008209 · keywords: Atlas Charts periodic versus nonperiodic date binning

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] With Month binning, Periodic pools matching months across years; nonperiodic bins retain year-month identity. The documentation's five-year example produces 12 periodic categories versus 60 nonperiodic categories. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/bin-data.md · keywords: Atlas Charts periodic versus nonperiodic date binning · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/customize-charts/field-level-options.md, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/chart-type-reference/candlestick-chart.md
- [statement] A March 2022 hands-on temperature-monitoring article uses discrete hourly periodic binning to show a typical daily profile, illustrating how recurring-hour summaries differ from a chronological trace. (medium confidence) — https://medium.com/@johnlpage/reduce-your-energy-bills-using-mongodb-part-2-getting-the-temperature-right-7f4366d93376 · keywords: Atlas Charts periodic versus nonperiodic date binning · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/bin-data.md

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Charts forces Periodic on for Day of the Week and off for Year, its largest supported time period. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/bin-data.md · keywords: Atlas Charts periodic versus nonperiodic date binning
- [statement] Periodic specifies grouping, not a mandatory sum. The binning documentation uses mean sales by recurring date-of-month; the line/area reference separately demonstrates count aggregation over periodic date-of-month bins. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/bin-data.md · keywords: Atlas Charts periodic versus nonperiodic date binning · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/chart-type-reference/line-area-chart.md
- [statement] Compare Periods requires a binned nonperiodic date category and an aggregation channel. Supported bar/column and discrete line/area charts can show cumulative totals or differences from the preceding chronological point; the first difference is blank. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/bin-data.md · keywords: Atlas Charts periodic versus nonperiodic date binning
